messages:
mike-adopt: Hi team — I finalized an adoption placement yesterday and need to add my child to benefits. SSN is pending (we have the placement paperwork). Can we add coverage now while SSN is in process, and how do we handle FSA elections and payroll?

zoe-peopleops: Congrats Mike! Short answer: yes, we can provision coverage pending SSN for adoptions. Please upload placement docs and the adoption agency letter to the portal. Weset a provisional dependent record while SSA processes the SSN.

mike-adopt: Great — uploading now. What's the provisional effective date we can use? Placement date is 2026-10-02.

zoe-peopleops: We typically set the effective date to the placement date (2026-10-02). Youhave 60 days to provide SSN once issued. If SSN arrives later we update the record; no gap in coverage. If SSN does not arrive in the vendor window, carrier may require extension paperwork but wework with them.

payroll: FYI on pay: premiums will be adjusted starting the pay period that includes 10/02. If you want payroll to spread the premium catch-up over following pay cycles (instead of a single retro deduction), let us know and we can request that from payroll processor. For FSA: you can change dependent care FSA during QLE if the plan allows because a new dependent was added via adoption. Upload the paperwork and wewill process the midyear election change.

benefits-bot: :paperclip: Ticket B-98765 created "Adoption: provisional add for mike-adopt". Please attach placement docs to ticket.

laura-hr: Also note: for tax purposes, update W-4 and dependent care FSA limits may change. If you plan to contribute to Dependent Care FSA, we can pro-rate your annual election based on the remaining plan year and adjust payroll accordingly.

mike-adopt: Uploaded agency letter and placement form to the ticket. Electing to add dependent care FSA midyear. Please prorate my FSA and spread any premium retro adjustments over the next two pay cycles if possible.

zoe-peopleops: Received. Setting provisional effective 2026-10-02. Payroll: please prorate premiums and split any retro adjustments across the next two runs per Mike's ask. Benefits: process dependent care FSA midyear election and confirm new per-pay deduction.

payroll: Noted. Will prorate and split retro over next two cycles. Will also update the FSA deduction amount starting next payroll.

benefits-bot: Update: Ticket B-98765 moved to "In review" by zoe-peopleops at 2429987665.

mike-adopt: Thank you all appreciate the help and quick turnaround :heart:
